prompt: Create a cinematic panoramic environment artwork for a premium cyberpunk productivity application. Wide 16:9 composition, 1536x864 or larger. View from a high-rise hacker's hideout over a vast rain-soaked futuristic megacity at night. Powerful art direction: black cherry shadows, electric vermilion and hot pink light, pale yellow highlights; cinematic photographic concept art, intricate architectural detail, beautiful luminous fog, strong depth. Main hero tower and brightest magenta atmosphere on RIGHT THIRD; left half dark open negative space for large pale yellow interface typography. Bottom third very dark buildings. The city must feel enormous, vivid, immersive, genuinely spectacular and futuristic. No people, no interface elements, no UI frames, no buttons, no logos, no legible words, no text, no watermarks. This is atmospheric artwork, not a screenshot or mockup. The resulting image will be used as a real background asset in the app.
